It helps optimize day-to-day operations for project development and acquiring traffic and clients: creating clean audience databases, sending structured emails, maintaining active chats with scheduled content, and measuring results using reports. Spoiler: Usability Interface Why it’s effective for Telegram promotion End-to-end workflow in one place: accounts → audience → outreach → engagement → reporting. Scale without chaos: bulk actions and automation reduce manual work and operational mistakes. Better targeting: collect audiences from chats/channels/comments and segment databases before outreach. Consistent activity: autoposting + ChatGPT features help maintain presence and speed up communication. Agency-friendly control: exports + calculators + report generation for client delivery. Core promotion/marketing features Mass messaging DM: send by username / ID / phone / contacts (incl. GPT scenarios where applicable). Inviting tools: invite by username / ID / phone / contacts to grow chats and funnels. Neuro-Commenting (ChatGPT) : Automated commenting workflows to promote your project in thematic channels related to the post's topic. Autoposting to chats: autoposting v1 / v2 (GPT) for steady community activity. Audience collection: scrape members / commenters / active writers and organize databases.
